tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: What GingerLive is: positioning summary, streaming platforms, network stats, third-party measurement partners, and contact links.

tools.name: get_network_stats
tools.description: GingerLive's network reach and performance numbers: streamer count, annual unique reach, hours of livestream watched monthly, and ad view-through rate.

tools.name: list_ad_formats
tools.description: The livestream ad formats GingerLive offers to brands, each with a description, plus the format badges (e.g. unskippable, adblock-safe).

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: GingerLive campaign case studies, each with a short excerpt and a link. Call get_case_study with a slug for the full write-up.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Full write-up for one case study. Pass a slug returned by list_case_studies.

tools.name: get_streamer_program_info
tools.description: How a streamer joins and monetizes with GingerLive: cost, how it works, supported platforms, and the sign-up link.

labels.name: get_case_study
labels.description: Returns one GingerLive campaign case study: title, date, URL and the full markdown write-up (brand, approach and results). Requires a slug from list_case_studies; an unknown slug returns the list of valid slugs. Read-only.

labels.name: get_streamer_program_info
labels.description: Returns how livestreamers join and earn with GingerLive: cost (free for streamers), how the in-stream ad program works, supported platforms and the sign-up link. Use for creator or streamer monetization questions; for brand-side questions use get_company_overview or list_ad_formats instead. Read-onl
